verdict.rationale: Tavily's SDK and MCP server are explicitly designed for LLM/agent consumption (one-line qna_search 'Perfect for usage by LLMs!', context strings for RAG, and an MCP server compatible with Cursor, Claude Desktop, and any MCP client), showing clear agent-framework integration intent. However, there is no explicit documentation of function-calling schemas (e.g., OpenAI-style JSON tool schemas) or dedicated LangChain/CrewAI wrapper packages, and an OpenAPI spec probe returned 404s. Missing for 10: documented function-calling/tool schema definitions, explicit third-party agent-framework SDK integrations beyond MCP, and a public OpenAPI spec.
